name: Naara
title: Wife of Ashhur
summary: Naara was one of the two wives of Ashhur, father of Tekoa. She is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogies of the tribe of Judah. Through her sons, she contributed to the establishment of important family lines in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as wife of Ashhur
keyEvents.description: Naara is mentioned as one of Ashhur's two wives in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, alongside Helah.

keyEvents.title: Naara's sons are mentioned
keyEvents.description: Naara's four sons—Ahuzzam, Hefer, Temeni and Haahashtari—are listed as part of the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Ashhur's role as father of Tekoa
keyEvents.description: Naara's husband Ashhur is identified as the father of Tekoa, an important city in Judah that later became known in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: The lineage in the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Naara is part of the broader family history of the tribe of Judah documented in 1 Chronicles, showing God's faithfulness through generations.
